_comment: Per-file line cap for hand-written code modules, enforced by the harness (PreToolUse block) and `interlinked verify` (large_files check). `files` grandfathers offenders (repo-relative path -> recorded line count): a listed file may shrink or hold, but the harness blocks any edit that grows it and verify fails it. Ratcheted 1500 -> 1000 on 2026-06-01, then 1000 -> 800 on 2026-06-03 after decomposing the 14 modules in the 800-1000 band (each split into a re-exporting public entry + sibling helper modules; importers unchanged). The two former entries (hook-template-chunks/session-state.ts, hooks-template.ts) are codegen DATA — the generated .mjs hook script carried as template strings — and are now exempt via the `@codegen-data` header marker (isCappableFile) rather than grandfathered, so the list is empty. To tighten further (800 -> 500), lower `max_lines` AND DEFAULT_MAX_LINES together (the pinning test in large-file-policy.test.ts enforces equality); the fine-grained complexity/cyclomatic checks do the sub-cap 'is this file actually bad' work. Policy: src/harness/large-file-policy.ts.
